browser_export.behavior: No browser launch. Authenticates real relocated cookie via /auth/session before returning Page. Parent owns and closes adapter. Direct cookie identity must match actor; bearer alone is insufficient.

ui-runtime.behavior: freshAgent uses actual POST /agents, lifecycle polling, exact runtime readback and public Sandbox retirement. Cleanup registered before mutation. Unknown creation never replayed or rekeyed.

ui-scenarios.contract: Low-level parent preparation factories receive {ctx,freshAgent}. Return actual fixture data plus local=true,run_owned=true,webSource,principal,cleanup. No case verdicts, step runners, arbitrary selectors, database edits or fabricated API responses. Register cleanup before every owned operation. Missing providers stay BLOCKED.
agent-history: owned Agent with completed+interrupted turns and >2 messages
agent-stop: stopBarrier.release/restore; cleanup restores on any failure
agent-delete: exact public cleanup for both fixtures
trigger-published: owned published Trigger with independent placement

evidence: Actual request IDs, selected compiled Web source/manifest, current owner/epoch and non-owner writes. Explicit peer GET/HEAD may reach owner. Each row needs both-AM browser receipts. N3 + parent restart/N1 remain parent responsibilities. No old-image or mocked PASS.
